main_sequences: 60 UA-DETRAC train sequences; no train metrics calculated in technical pilot
technical_pilot: test MVI_39031 MVI_39051 MVI_39211 frames 1-120; excluded from hypothesis tests
threshold_rationale: A priori practical study targets, not literature-derived expected effects: 10 pp is twice the 5 pp quality tolerance; 3 pp is 60% of that tolerance and is the minimum between-group difference deemed worth discussing. These are design conventions, not established safety limits or effect estimates. No post-result threshold changes.

kmax.rule: largest k for which simultaneous upper bound on mean full-frame HOTA loss is <=5 pp for every tested j=2..k
kmax.fallback: 1 is a conservative selection under uncertainty, not proof all larger intervals are unsuitable
kmax.family: 27 upper quality bounds: 3 groups x 9 intervals

density: GT valid boxes per annotated frame; absent XML frames excluded, NOT treated as empty; groups 20/20/20
ignored_region: clip to original image; exact union IoA > 0.5 excluded on both GT and detections and final outputs
coordinates: absolute continuous original-image xyxy; XML left/top no -1; MOT left/top/width/height passed unchanged through TrackEval
output: confirmed tracked KF forecasts on skipped frames; unconfirmed and lost suppressed; no future interpolation
pilot_timing: 3 warmup calls, cached detector quality pipeline; NOT a runtime benchmark
unannotated_frames: Process timeline normally; mask both GT and predictions out of evaluation and density; do not compress time; genuine annotated empty frames remain scored
